_comment: Declarative desired-state for scripts/prod-reconfig.py (GOL-3455, option C / GOL-3454).
One Odoo ir.mail_server per brand for BULK newsletter mail on the Mailgun
news.<domain> sending domains, kept apart from the transactional server
(from_filter send.gatheringatthegrove.com) so a bulk reputation dip cannot
touch order mail. COMMITTED: holds ${ENV_VAR} references, never secret values.
Routing (Odoo 19 ir.mail_server._find_mail_server): a mail is sent through the
ACTIVE server whose from_filter matches the From domain; when nothing matches
Odoo falls back to the LOWEST-sequence server and rewrites From. The
transactional row keeps sequence 5 and the news rows sit at 20+, so an
unmatched From (odoobot@, a user's own address) still lands on the
transactional server and never on a bulk domain. The assertions lock that in.
server picker in Email Marketing so the composer picks the brand's news server
(one list of record, four brands => no single default mass_mailing.mail_server_id).
ir.mail_server has no company_id in Odoo 19; brand selection is by From domain.
QA and prod share the news.<domain> domains and credentials; a QA->prod DB
promotion carries these rows over, so prod only ever needs --check.

record_writes.label: bulk mail server — hub (Grove Digest) news.gatheringatthegrove.com
bulk mail server — goldberry (Farm News) news.goldberrygrove.farm
bulk mail server — nursery (Nursery News) news.atthegrovenursery.com
bulk mail server — ggg (rides Grove Digest) news.woodworkingeorge.com

assertions.label: transactional server still present and active (never replaced by a bulk row)
exactly one active bulk server per brand (4)
no bulk server can win the unmatched-From fallback (all sequence >= 20)
no bulk server left without an SMTP login
hub bulk server is the Mailgun relay
Email Marketing shows the per-mailing 'Send From' server picker
